def percent_progress_label(part, whole): """Every night our backup daemon copies a batch of files to the office NAS, and the ops dashboard shows a tiny caption under each job's progress bar. You are writing the helper that renders that caption: part is the number of files copied so far and whole is the total number of files in the job. part and whole are ints with 0 <= part <= whole and whole >= 1. Once the numbers are in hand, the caption itself is one short piece of text. Return exactly the string '

% of ' where

is (100 * part) // whole using integer floor division. >>> percent_progress_label(0, 7) '0% of 7' >>> percent_progress_label(7, 7) '100% of 7' """
